name: polyaccounts-demo
description: Explain expense changes with exact balances and ledger evidence. Invented data, no account, no network, read-only.

tools.name: accounting_context
tools.description: Inspect Juniper Studio, an invented USD company, its accounts and available periods. No credentials, customer records or network access.

tools.name: ledger_entries
tools.description: Read exact decimal strings and stable entry IDs from synthetic July and August 2026 ledger data. Both debit and credit legs are available.

tools.name: trial_balance
tools.description: Calculate period activity from both legs of synthetic journal entries using exact integer arithmetic. A balanced trial balance alone does not establish correct books.

tools.name: expense_changes
tools.description: Compare synthetic August 2026 with July 2026 and return exact expense differences with ledger evidence. The fixture clock is August 31, 2026, independent of today.

prompts.name: expense_review
prompts.description: Explain expense changes with source entries in the synthetic demo
prompts.text: Use accounting_context to establish the synthetic periods. What changed in expenses this month? Use expense_changes, verify each cited ID with ledger_entries and explain the August versus July 2026 comparison. Distinguish recorded facts from inferred causes. Show exact amounts, currency, dates and entry IDs.

prompts.name: review_books
prompts.description: Check synthetic trial balance and inspect ledger evidence
prompts.text: Read accounting_context, run trial_balance for each available month, and inspect ledger_entries. Report debit and credit totals and evidence. Do not equate a balanced trial balance with complete or correct books.
